symptom: 5 epoch route_recovery auxiliary staged behavior clone with entropy_regularization 0.08 survived the 5 second toy load smoke but selected action 3 on 151/151 frames, producing zero action entropy.
root_cause: Increasing supervised epochs and entropy regularization improved offline validation metrics but did not repair deterministic low entropy in the 5 second online smoke. Follow-up offline diagnostics show the full mixed dataset does not globally collapse, an absolute-time conditioning fix did not remove the 5 second action 3 loop, and nearest-neighbor comparison against same-map 0-60 second opening samples found 147/151 nearest teacher targets are also action 3. A 60 second follow-up shows the checkpoint can eventually leave action 3, but the stride-10 sampled nearest teacher target changes at 7.0 seconds while the online policy first changes at 22.6667 seconds, with larger mismatches in the 25-35 second and 55-60 second windows. The current failure is therefore best understood as a transition / recovery timing problem after an overly narrow opening segment.
fix: Keep this checkpoint as repair evidence only. Absolute-time conditioning is now internally consistent, but this checkpoint needs longer-window teacher trajectory inspection, GRU history diagnostics, and explicit recovery / action-change supervision before any policy promotion.
validation: Recorded in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_entropy_retry_001/evaluation_5s_soda.json and harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_absolute_time_conditioning_fix_001/evaluation_5s_soda.json; both keep action 3 ratio 1.0 with low_action_entropy and gate_decision evaluation_recorded_needs_action_bias_repair. Five-second nearest-neighbor evidence is in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_absolute_time_conditioning_fix_001/trace_dataset_nearest_opening.json with nearest_target_matches_online_action_ratio 0.9735. Sixty-second transition evidence is in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_60s_nearest_transition_001/trace_dataset_nearest_60s.json with first_online_action_change at 22.6667 seconds and first_nearest_target_change at 7.0 seconds on a stride-10 sampled trace.
